preview: Why do some people wake up just before an alarm? This episode looks at research on the body’s timing and what that research can and cannot tell us. By the end, you will understand why this experience is still not fully explained.
comment_1: Listen for what the body may do before an expected wake-up time.
comment_2: So far, the key idea is that the body may prepare to wake before an expected time. But how closely does this evidence explain the feeling of waking just before an alarm?
comment_3: Waking up just before an alarm may be connected to the body’s daily timing system. The body may start preparing before sleep ends, but it cannot always wake at exactly the right time. Now, let’s look at two more ways to understand this experience.
comment_4: Regular light and daily routines may help keep the body’s timing steady. Practice and expectation may also affect waking for some people. Now let’s bring these ideas together.
